en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hillside cityscape with stone defensive walls and houses built along the top of the walls and on the surrounding slopes. Dense vegetation and gardens cover the foreground. At the top left there is printed French text identifying the view as a souvenir from Trebizonde and specifying the walls of "Dabak-Hané." A handwritten date in French reading "le 31 Décembre 1913" appears across the upper part. A small website watermark (elia.org.gr) is printed near the bottom right.
